games.title: Orchard
games.blurb: Swipe to steer your snake around a wrapping orchard and hold to sprint. Fruit makes you longer, bombs cost a hundred, and driving your nose into the other snake scores; five hits wins the match.

games.title: Air Hockey
games.blurb: Drag your thumb across your own half to slide your mallet and knock the puck into the goal slot behind your opponent. Each phone shows the table from its own end, and seven goals takes the match.
